NOT authored from: segment 0's one anchored mouse.click. Its hand-authored anchor.rect sits ~316-320 px from where an unstyled <button> lands in any real browser, so the alignment check reports `uncertain` there forever (T5.4/T5.6 finding, reproduced tri-engine and independently by a reviewer).
